text:
Sofia: Heads up - demo for FinSecure trial started hitting 5xxs at ~14:02PT during a synthetic replay. Bursty traffic ~280 rps. Sales flagged CISO wants quick RCA and cost estimate for a mitigation.

ops-bot: autoscaler: requested scale-up for fintrial-pool at 14:03:05; +2 nodes.

Priya: What codes? sample request ids? model?

Sofia: Mostly 502/503, sample ids: 7a1c2f, c3b9d4. Model: r-instruct-large-v1 (hosted). Payloads are small single-turn prompts.

Ethan: Checking traces. Pattern: frontdoor queue grows -> backend grpc UNAVAILABLE -> frontdoor surfaces 502. New instances take ~16-20s to mark Ready due to quant kernel warmup. No OOMs.

Maya: Short-term options: (1) tenant warm instance (prewarmed GPU) for demo window, (2) set tenant fallback to r-instruct-medium-quant on overload, (3) reduce tenant batch_size. Which should we push?

Sofia: Sales wants lowest-cost play that reduces chances of 5xxs for the live demo. Also CISO asked for log bundle and retention confirmation.

Priya: For demo safety: enable 1 prewarm GPU for 4 hours + tenant fallback + set max_batch=1. I'll draft pricing and a note about retention.

ops-bot: apply: tenant(finsecure).max_batch=1 -> accepted
ops-bot: apply: tenant(finsecure).fallback=r-instruct-medium-quant -> accepted

ops-bot: prewarm: provisioning 1-gpu for tenant finsecure duration=4h -> accepted

Ethan: Uploaded diag bundle: https://redwood-internal/diag/2647890123 (frontdoor spans, instance logs, model load timestamps). Default diag retention 30d; security@redwood.ai can extend on request.

Sofia: Sales: cost for 4h prewarm?

Priya: Estimate: $0.65/hr -> ~ $2.60 for 4h. We can absorb first 2h as a gesture for trials; remainder billed. I'll send a short quote.

Maya: Also recommend client retries (2) with jitter and small backoff. Quick snippet: curl to /v1/generate with batch_size=1.

Ethan: After changes queue depth dropped and 5xx rate fell from ~9% -> 0.7% in 6 minutes. Monitoring continues.

Sofia: I'll inform FinSecure and schedule a 5-min practice run right before the demo. CISO info included the diag link and retention note.

Priya: Logged follow-ups: (a) ops to consider persistent warm pool option for high-value trials, (b) add prewarm cost to trial playbook, (c) add a short runbook for fallback routing.

sales-bot: Noted. Client wants "no 5xx" guarantee - we must avoid that wording; we will offer an SLA-backed Dedicated option if they need guarantees.

Sofia: Thanks team. Will revert temporary configs after 4h unless extended by sales.
